delmas.device: SR Research EyeLink 1000 (EDF header: VERSION: EYELINK II 1; EYELINK II CL v4.594 Jul  6 2012)
delmas.device_source: EDF/ASC header in the data; model name from the paper
delmas.pct_samples_missing_definition: gaze or pupil not valid in the 5-s display windows, 1000 Hz, mean over 75 participants
delmas.pct_trials_excluded: 5.7% of image rows (4,525 of 4,800 participant x image rows kept in the authors' table: ambiguous or misidentified faces removed by the authors); main-session trials: 64 of 64 kept per participant (0%)
delmas.pct_participants_excluded: 0 of 75 in the released tables (participants removed by the authors before release: not available)

calibration_validation_error_deg.quantity: EyeLink HV9 validation, average error per validation, mean over the validations of the main session (per participant)

class_difference.note: classes are known versus unknown faces within each participant; data loss compared across the five groups

celniak.device: Tobii Pro Fusion (remote), Tobii Pro Lab export (events from the vendor classifier)
celniak.device_source: dataset loader docstring and Zenodo description in the repository; model not stored in the sample files
celniak.rate_source: sample timestamps (median inter-sample interval) of each recording
celniak.eyes: both eyes recorded; validity per eye in the export; pupil = Tobii filtered diameter (mm), fallback mean of the two eyes
celniak.pct_samples_missing_definition: samples inside the 7.5-s question slides where at least one eye is not Valid (mean over recordings); both eyes invalid: 21.46%
celniak.pct_trials_excluded: 0% by us (21 slides per recording kept); recordings with a slide valid below 50%: 19 of 39 recordings, 147 of 819 slides
celniak.pct_participants_excluded: 0 of 39 recordings in the deposit (exclusions made by the authors before deposit: not available)

calibration_validation_error_deg.quantity: Tobii Pro Lab 'Average validation accuracy (degrees)' (the variable used in the confound analysis, as log), 'Average calibration accuracy' and 'Average validation precision RMS'

preti.device: eye tracker (model not reported in the deposit)
preti.rate_source: deposit holds fixation-level rows (about 7.3 per trial), no samples
preti.pct_samples_missing_definition: no sample-level data; proxy: share of fixation rows flagged as blink = 7.0%; fixation rows with missing pupil = 0.0%
preti.pct_trials_excluded: error trials (outcome 1) are 4.3% of 1824 trials; pupil sheet holds 1819 of 1824 trials (0.27% without a corrected pupil value); none removed by us
preti.pct_participants_excluded: v1 deposit holds 60 participants, the analysed v2 deposit 57 (3 removed by the authors, all liars)

class_difference.note: class 1 = liar; blink share per participant

colasanti.dataset: Colasanti et al. 2024 (RealEye webcam crime scene; Mazza data)
colasanti.device: RealEye webcam eye tracking (HD webcam 1080p at 60 fps, Chrome)
colasanti.device_source: Colasanti et al. 2023 (repository copy of the paper)
colasanti.sampling_rate_hz: 60 nominal (paper: a gaze sample at least every 16 ms); effective rate not recorded
colasanti.rate_source: paper text; deposit has per-participant aggregates only
colasanti.pct_samples_missing_definition: aggregate fixation tables only, no sample-level data
colasanti.pct_participants_excluded: 3 of 160 (1.8%) excluded by the authors for technical problems; 157 analysed in the deposit

calibration_validation_error_deg.note: RealEye platform accuracy 90 to 156 px, 113 px on average (Lewandowska 2020, quoted in the paper); no per-participant calibration value in the deposit

completeness.C3: complete (5 datasets; Liar's Dice omitted, see DEVIATIONS 5)
